**Verdict: FAIL.** The candidate is DG6 `sha256:7d6b4a9f…08cb` (2708 files, source `3cce3d4452fcd91e3db2888c60271e5afdc06062`), and its ID matched at the start and end of the run. I raised four Medium findings. D-192 says a Medium finding can't be accepted as an observation, so they must be repaired before the gate. There are also four Low findings.

Every requested suite ran in disposable clones. Every test passed, either in its full run or when that file was re-run alone:

- **Static checks:** all 7 exit 0. The contrast check passes 50 pairs, and the 3 prohibited pairs fail as documented.
- **Unit:** Node 22 and Node 24, each with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8: all 4 runs exit 0. The Node 22 present is v22.22.0, not the 22.22.2 the assignment names.
- **Integration:** run twice over all 410 files. `contract.test.ts` passed 105/105, 932 of 932 operations have a validated response, and every p6-pending list is empty.
- **`tests/qa` alone:** 45/45 integration files and 6/6 unit files pass.
- **e2e:** the root acceptance specs, product journeys and demo specs all pass in en and ar under both locale settings. axe reports no serious or critical issues.
- **Validators:** register DG6, pipeline, and historical DG5 to DG1 all pass.
- **Environmental residuals:** the Keycloak login spec was not run (no container runtime), which the assignment treats as a residual rather than BLOCKED. The OIDC checks passed against the bundled test issuer.

Three reviews shared 4 cores, and the load reached 33. That caused Chromium crashes, test timeouts, and 2-hour background-limit stops. Each is labelled in the logs, re-run alone, and explained in `RUN-NOTES.md`; no timeout was counted as a pass.

My own probes covered several clauses the register notes said were only partly tested, and all passed:
- the full keyboard walkthrough;
- the literal "KPI-001" and "12.5%" in Arabic exports;
- a real 400 validation error shown in Arabic;
- connector row counts shown on screen;
- clearing all browser storage loses no submitted data;
- the 1440 px layout with demo data;
- an auditor read-only pass over the P6 screens.

| Finding | Severity | Requirement | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-DG6-140 | Medium | REQ-S12-019 | Once a later reporting period is open, the freshness scan never raises a stale-data exception. In normal monthly operation that half of the requirement does nothing; ADR-0053 records it as open and undecided. |
| F-DG6-141 | Medium | REQ-S16-030 | The export rate limit and the import-upload rate limit specified in ADR-0052 §4 are not wired. `EXPORT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` is documented but has no effect. |
| F-DG6-142 | Medium | REQ-S20-029 | The load-data generator in the tree writes invalid UUIDs that the API rejects with 400. Every DG6 load figure came from a patched copy that isn't in the tree. |
| F-DG6-147 | Medium | REQ-S20-030 | With 50 exports started at once, 38 took longer than 2 s, even on a host meeting the idle criterion D-202 relied on. This contradicts the measurement D-202 accepted; job IDs, progress and requester-only downloads all held. |
| F-DG6-143 | Low | REQ-S15-009 | The Upload policy admin screen scrolls horizontally at 360 px in English because a status chip doesn't wrap. |
| F-DG6-144 | Low | REQ-DLV-038 | The DG5 carry-forward sweep of 30 s test budgets wasn't done. Five journeys fail even alone under load and pass on a quiet host. |
| F-DG6-145 | Low | REQ-DLV-038 | Two integration tests (`route-inventory` and `dependency-slip-relay`) check database-wide state that changes legitimately under load. Both pass alone. |
| F-DG6-146 | Low | REQ-S16-027 | `createTomGap` returns 422 instead of the uniform 400 for a missing required field. This was proposed during implementation but never logged as a finding. |

None of these is an authorization hole, a wrong financial result, or a business approval that can be forged, and none is a mandatory violation.

I opened no other reviewer's record. At the final identity check, `git log` showed the subject lines of their auto-committed evidence, after my findings were already written.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- reviews/DG6/round-1/qa-verifier.json
- reviews/DG6/round-1/qa-verifier.findings.json
- reviews/DG6/round-1/qa-verifier.md
- test-evidence/DG6/qa/round-1/ (start with `RUN-NOTES.md` and `16-requirements-matrix.md`)
- test-evidence/DG6/qa/tests/round-1/ (my probes)
